verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents its own automation surfaces: Shortcuts actions and an x-callback-url scheme that let external tools drive the app programmatically. The evidence only names these interfaces without detailing endpoints or commands, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. missing for 10: a documented reference of x-callback-url/Shortcuts actions and parameters, a network-accessible public API (REST/OpenAPI), independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use Shortcuts and x-callback-url for automation.
Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.
